skills.name: Might Be Sort of Fun
skills.description: Wields her weapon with ease.  Good effects on allies.    *Changes regular attacks to area attacks (14 sec) *ATK +300% (14 sec)

skills.name: Number 1: Falling Thunder
skills.description: Moves swiftly and jumps up high,  swinging her axe down from above.  Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Nullifies debuff-canceling skills (5 sec) *Enemy Physical DEF -150000 (7 sec) *ATK x 4600% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: Kaiju No. 8
abilities.description: Kaiju No. 8 Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Persistence+
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability activate Persistence when defeated. When Persistence activates, Rangers hold on for 7 more seconds with a dramatic ATK increase.
